purpose: Bright-failure association diagnostic; not a causal inference

definitions.bright: any observed AIA channel >= its threshold; quiet is the valid complement
definitions.valid: finite reference DEM and finite prediction (as eval_full_paper_test.py)
definitions.multimodal: zero-padded curve, >=2 interior peaks with prominence >= 0.15 x curve max
definitions.along/orthogonal: exact split of per-pixel SSE: component of (pred-ref) along ref, and the rest
definitions.relative_sse: group SSE / group sum of squared reference DEM
definitions.intensity: max over channels of observed / threshold
definitions.solver_scatter: bit-identical AIA blocks grouped; per-bin variance of solver DEM across targets

solver_scatter.note: model MSE over repeated targets = model bias (distance to the mean solver DEM) + solver scatter (variance of the solver DEM across targets)
